$Comment: A Jack Skeleton: the game's Skeleton Fighter under a carved pumpkin, out at night while Hallow's Eve runs. It is a Variant of Template_Intelligent rather than of Skeleton_Fighter because a Variant's Modify reaches only the Parameters its immediate Reference declares; so this Modify is Skeleton_Fighter's own, with the look, the drop list and the nameplate changed, its Memories leaves replaced by IsMemory false, and the wandering values written in place of the ones that file computes. Any key the template does not declare makes the game refuse the whole role, and the creature never spawns. Weapons draws one of the game's own skeleton weapons; FlockArray lets a Jack Skeleton arrive with a second one. IsMemory is false so a creature that walks a few weeks a year stays out of the Memories collection. It spawns only through this pack's calendar rules (CalendarSpawns/HallowsEvePack).
